question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Eficcient"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Efficient".
 
• **"Eficcient" (Incorrect):** There is no meaning for this misspelled word in English or Hindi as it is invalid.
 
• **"Efficient" (Correct):** Means being productive without wasting time or resources. (कुशल)
 
 
• **Example:** She is an efficient worker who completes her tasks ahead of deadlines.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Belligerent **(युद्धोन्मत्त): Hostile and aggressive in behavior.

 
 
• **Example:** His belligerent attitude caused the argument to escalate quickly.
 
 
 
• **Tournament **(प्रतियोगिता): A competition involving a series of games or matches.
 
 
• **Example:** The football tournament will start next week.
 
 
 
• **Parliament **(संसद): The highest legislative body in a country.
 
 
• **Example:** Important decisions were made during the parliament session.
